name: Browser Toolkit
description: Use Browser Toolkit in Recued to let your AI list your open tabs, open pages, read them and their tables, ask them questions, take screenshots, scroll them, wait for them to change, and type, click, press keys and send forms on them in Chrome through the Browser Bridge, on sites you are signed in to, one step or many across tabs at a time. Every new tab, typing, click, key and set of steps asks you first, unless you've allowed it on that site.
